name: Steinbacher
beschreibung: The Ferienwohnung Steinbacher is situated on the quiet outskirts of Schwoich, an idyllic village in the Tyrolean Unterland. Surrounded by rolling meadows and lush mountain slopes, the property is just a few minutes' drive from central Kufstein. Guests can expect a simply furnished holiday apartment complete with a fully equipped kitchen and private balcony, ideal for self-catering. It serves as an excellent base for hiking and outdoor adventures in the Kaiser Mountains.
